zajjaj:1-1.t:
Sūrat al-Naṣr
Medinan
﷽
His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿إذا جاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ والفَتْحُ﴾ ("when the help of Allah and the victory come"): it was said that the victory, as has come in the exegesis, [means] that the Prophet's ﷺ own death was announced to him in this sūra: Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, let him know that when the conquest of Mecca came and people entered Islam in crowds, his appointed term ﷺ had drawn near. He used to say that: «”إنَّهُ قَدْ نُعِيَتْ إلَيَّ نَفْسِي في هَذِهِ السُّورَةِ“» ("my death has been announced to me in this sūra"). So Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, commanded him to increase glorification and seeking forgiveness, so that He might seal for him, at the end of his life, with an increase in righteous deeds, by following what He commanded him.

zajjaj:2-2.t: ﴿وَرَأيْتَ النّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ في دِينِ اللَّهِ أفْواجًا﴾ ("and you see people entering the religion of Allah in crowds"): the meaning of ﴿أفْواجًا﴾ is large groups; that is, after they used to enter one by one and two by two, the tribe came to enter Islam in its entirety.
